description:
How did our human ancestors die? Scientists have read the clues in their bones, and some readings are still argued over: a fall from a tree, a cave shaft, an eagle's talons, a leopard's fangs, a crocodile's bite, too much vitamin A and a giant hyena's den. Doug visits each fossil's death scene, from Lucy to Peking Man, ranked from bad luck to being stored as food.

Which death was worst? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
